snippet.title: Tiny Kitchen: Burger Edition - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Tiny Kitchen: Burger Edition is a relaxing food-truck game where you build burgers using simple one-click controls. Click a button to drop an ingredient, and watch as physics creates delicious—and slightly ridiculous—chaos. It's perfect for a focused gaming session or for playing in the background while you work or study.

WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3840240/Tiny_Kitchen_Burger_Edition/
